title: Data, Models, Graphs, and Medical Evidence
purpose: Interpret data tables, graphs, anatomical models, and medical evidence.
required_visual_model_data: Data table; graph; anatomical model; medical evidence table

direct_resource.Title: OpenStax: Medical Imaging
direct_resource.Task: Click the link and use the medical imaging section. Observe how images, models, and evidence help scientists study the body without guessing. Record one imaging tool, what evidence it provides, and one limitation.

mastery_rule: Student can explain the lesson standard with structure-function reasoning and visual/data evidence.
